channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Move on, says Trump as Epstein files trigger probe into British politician
item.description: WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump made a fresh plea Tuesday for Americans to move on from the Jeffrey Epstein scandal, even as it left a prominent British politician facing a criminal probe on the other side of the Atlantic.

item.title: Seven soccer venues announced for 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: LOS ANGELES: Organisers of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics on Tuesday announced the seven venues that will host the men’s and women’s group stage and knockout matches.

item.title: Teen sentenced to 100 hours' community service for injuring former police chief
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A 16-year-old boy who admitted to injuring former Dang Wangi police chief Senior Assistant Commissioner Sulizmie Affendy Sulaiman last year was sentenced by the magistrate’s court today to 100 hours of community service.

item.title: PM: Malaysia secured 780ha of territory following border talks with Indonesia
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia has secured 7.8sq km of territory along Sungai Sinapat and Sungai Sesai following negotiations with Indonesia on Outstanding Border Problem (OBP) areas, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim told the Dewan Rakyat today.

item.title: MyDigital ID not mandatory for security, immigration services
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government will not make MyDigital ID the sole method of identity verification for security and immigration-related services, the Dewan Rakyat was told today.

item.title: Binastra wins RM503mil data centre contract
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Binastra Corp Bhd’s unit Binastra Builders Sdn Bhd has received a contract from Exsim Sri Permai Sdn Bhd to develop a data centre in KL worth RM503 million.

item.title: Johor rolls out on-site detention system to address decade-long flash floods
item.description: JOHOR BARU: After years of recurring flash floods in urban and residential areas, the Johor government has identified key flood hotspots for the implementation of innovative On-Site Detention (OSD) systems to improve stormwater management.

item.title: 50-year-old widower, 30-year-old divorcee held in 'khalwat' raid in Ulu Tiram
item.description: JOHOR BARU: A 50-year-old widower and a 30-year-old divorcee were detained in a hotel in Ulu Tiram over ‘khalwat’ early this morning.

item.title: Sepang test: Yamaha absent as Mir and Morbidelli set the pace in FP3
item.description: SEPANG: Joan Mir and Franco Morbidelli turned up the pace as Yamaha sat out the morning session on the second day of official MotoGP testing at Sepang Circuit today (Feb 4).
